# Sunny Daze (G4)

Sunny Daze is the little golden-yellow Earth pony with a swept white mane and tail, turquoise eyes, and a sun cutie mark. Look for her beside orange-maned Peachy Pie: the two school-age best friends are remembered for performing poetry **on roller skates** at Ponyville's talent show. The licensed *Elements of Harmony Vol. II* guidebook also describes their close friendship ([character and publication details](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Sunny_Daze_and_Peachy_Pie)).

[![Sunny Daze (left, blue skates) with Peachy Pie after the school talent show](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2020/7/12/401548/full.png)](https://twibooru.org/401548)
*Show still from “The Show Stoppers”; animation: Studio B Productions for Hasbro Studios.*

[![G3 and G4 Sunny Daze and Peachy Pie together](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2022/1/9/2627364/full.png)](https://twibooru.org/2627364)
*Cross-generation fan artwork credited to AndromendaSkies in the artwork's artist tag.*

**Name and continuity.** Cheerilee calls her *Sunny Daze* by name in “The Show Stoppers,” so this is an on-screen name, not merely a fan nickname. A different **G3 Sunny Daze** predates her; they are not the same character across continuities. Some G4 merchandise independently uses Sunny Daze for a **purple Pegasus baby**, unlike the show's yellow Earth pony ([2011 So Soft Newborn toy record](https://data.mlpmerch.com/brushables/details/osssnsd/)). No secret identity or transformation is established for the filly.

**Speaking and appearances.** Sunny has no identifiable solo spoken dialogue or credited television voice actor; she and Peachy Pie audibly gasp when their award is announced. They are visible in **“The Show Stoppers” (S1E18)**, **“The Cutie Pox” (S2E6)**, **“Pinkie Pride” (S4E12)** as part of a singing crowd, and **“The Fault in Our Cutie Marks” (S6E19)** watching Gabby's baseball attempt. Crowd singing should not be mistaken for an individually credited speaking role.

## Important moments

- **Poetry on wheels — “The Show Stoppers” (S1E18):** Cheerilee introduces Sunny and Peachy's unusual roller-skating poetry act, their defining on-screen appearance. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qJ-koo_ASWc); scene timestamp unavailable.
- **Best Dramatic Performance — “The Show Stoppers” (S1E18):** They win the school's dramatic-performance award and react with delighted gasps. [Episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/The_Show_Stoppers); timestamp unavailable.
- **Following Apple Bloom's lead — “The Cutie Pox” (S2E6):** Sunny and Peachy seek loopty-hooping lessons after Apple Bloom impresses her classmates, showing how quickly her apparent talent catches on. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHoOy5TSByI); scene timestamp unavailable.
